tei:div.tei:p: 63)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: tshogs mchod bsdus pa bsod nams chu gter bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu la: brten nas bsod nams tshogs gsog thabs: rgyun khyer zab mo 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha'i nang: māṃ sa dza gad dpa' bo dang: bza' bca' btung ba longs spyod sogs: 'byor tshogs yo byad bkod legs bsags: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ: snang srid rnam dag bhan+dha'i nang: āḥ snod bcud 'dod yon tshogs su bshams: hūm̐: zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas: haḥ rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor rgyun: hoḥ ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: hrīḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: zad med gyur cig pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus che mchog he ru ka: rig stong rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: bde stong zag med dza gad bdud rtsi dang: kun snang bkod pa phyi nang gsang mchod sogs: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi 64)mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes dgyes par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol: pañca a mṛ ta ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa skong ba'i phyir: phyi mchod 'dod yon lnga yis thugs dam bskang: nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg byas bskang: gsang mchod sman gtor rak+tas thugs dam bskang: sbyor sgrol kho na nyid kyis thugs= bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bdag ni ma rig bag med dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma spyad nyes tshogs kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya nas āḥbar: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag med lta ba'i he ru kas: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang ru tra bkug: ye shes 'bar ba'i mtshon gyis bsgral:

'khor ba'i lhag ma dbyings su bstabs: ru tra mā ra ya phaṭaḥ kha raṃ khā hiḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho sid+dhi hūm̐: pheṃ: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams: 'dod yon tshogs lhag 'di rol la: gang brtsams phrin las 'grub 65)par mdzod: sa ma ya uts+tshiṣa ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ bh+yo: dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' srung ba: dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: gangs can brtan ma la sogs pa'i: 'jig 'das dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: chad don gtor ma 'di shes la: rnam bzhi'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: hūm̐: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i dgra dang bgegs: ye shes rol pa'i stobs kyis mnan: nam yang ldang med rgyas gdab bo: chos nyid stong pa'i mkha' ru brub: mā ra ya nan: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cig dgongs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dngos grub: ma lus dus 'dir bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hoḥ ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul dbang gis: lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel ba bshags: oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūm̐ sa ma ya: hoḥ 'dis mtshon bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngoḥ kun kyang srid pa 66) las sgrol nas: 'og min zhing la spyod par shog: hūm̐: thabs kyi skur bzhengs ye shes lha: shes rab stong pa'i dbyings su āḥ chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin: rjes snang sgyu ma'i lha skur bzhengs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden stobs kyis: sa gsum dge ba'i bkra shis shog: gzhan yang smon lam bkra shis kyis: mtha' brgyan las rjes gsang ba gnad: nyams pa rnams dang tshogs bsre spongs: tshul bzhin rgyun du nyams blangs na: nyams chags bskang shing bsod nam 'phel: tshe 'dir rkyen dang bar chad zhi:

mthar thug tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nges: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang dus ring mo nas rang slob dam pa bkra shis tshe ring sogs kyis nan cher bskul ngor chos med sprang mo su kha badz+ras dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bstus te dag par phab pa'o//
